hints.title: Proper Divisor Pairing
hints.text: A perfect number equals the sum of its positive proper divisors excluding itself. Divisors occur in symmetric pairs d and num divided by d.

hints.title: Square Root Divisor Bound Invariant
hints.text: Iterating up to the square root of num captures both paired divisors simultaneously without checking numbers beyond the square root.

hints.title: Symmetric Divisor Summation Procedure
hints.text: If num is at most one, return false. Initialize sum to one. Loop divisor d from two while d times d is at most num. If num modulo d equals zero, add d and num divided by d to sum when distinct. Return whether sum equals num.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(sqrt(N)) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all numbers from 1 to num - 1 takes O(N) operations, which times out for large integers up to 10^8.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pairwise divisor accumulation checks up to sqrt(num) in O(sqrt(N)) time and uses O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle num <= 1 as edge cases and avoid adding perfect square roots twice.
